objective: Reliable contact and grip-force feedback on thin ENPIRE/YAM fingers
architecture_review: Four digital build packages exist: R1, L1, B1 and B2.1. B2 now includes a checked consolidated PCB and removable support. All twelve designs remain in the build-and-compare campaign; no physical winner has been established.
next_experiment: Build the available R1/L1/B1/B2 packages while completing the remaining eight designs. Use common contact, force, precision, interference and repeatability tests through 20 N per finger; retain raw evidence and failed builds.
